author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab CI/CD has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229) actively exploited. Patch now to prevent severe compromise.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited: Brotli CVE-2026-111497 can mean RCE or memory disclosure when an app decompresses attacker-controlled data. Node.js: update 22.x to 22.23.4+, 24.x to 24.22.1+, or 26.x to 26.12.1+. .NET 8-11 are also affected.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure, missing authentication for critical function. On CISA KEV since 2026-10-30.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2).

author: Python_s_
text: Actively Exploited Arista VeloCloud SQL Injection Enables Superuser Privileges. CVE-2026-114625 CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9), VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Actively Exploited Access Bypass Flaw in Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539) lets unauthenticated attackers manipulate orders, tamper with prices, bypass payment verification.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-120209 (CVSS 9.8 Critical) - PoC Available. Hardcoded JWT secret in AJ-Report (<= 1.7.1) lets attackers forge Share-Tokens to reach testTransform for GroovyClassLoader RCE.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-120201 (CVSS 9.8 Critical) - PoC Available. Sending 'is not null' in the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header of Dromara Jpom (2.10.0-2.11.12) grants super-admin access and RCE.

author: Python_s_
text: Critical CVE-2025-54068 Laravel / Livewire: VulnCheck reports real-world exploitation activity; public PoC available.

author: Python_s_
text: Wasmtime ARM64 Sandbox Escape: Researcher Reports Host-Code Execution. CVE-2026-115893 / GHSA-mghf-wjfp-p5xm CRITICAL; PoC repository created Oct 27.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: Unauthenticated Linux Kernel RCE via MPTCP Listeners: security researchers at Anthropic have demonstrated a working exploit for a critical flaw.

author: salmanite
text: Node.js RCE Exploit CVE-2026-111497: XHack AI rebuilt the exploit in an isolated lab and confirmed Remote Code Execution on an unmodified Node.js build.

author: rst_cloud
text: The Shrinking Exploit Window: How AI Speeds Up the Hunt for Old Bugs (30-10-2026). Threats: P2pshell, Node2shell, MOTW bypass, supply chain.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: NVD published eight MCP command-injection CVEs in a three-second burst, and one is a Gemini CLI extension with no fixed version.

author: NewsTongueX
text: Brazilian court fines lawyers ~$16K for hidden prompt injection in a court filing aimed at the court's AI system.

author: CalatheaAI
text: Windows malware VOLTA uses LLMs to rank victims' assets by monetization value; stolen credentials and purchase receipts feed a victim dossier.

author: SpectraAudit
text: Cursor confirmed two modified versions of Anthropic's Claude Code extension (2.1.312 and 2.1.313) were distributed through its extension marketplace for Windows and macOS.

author: CyberWorldOps
text: Northflank urges secret resets after customers' AI API keys were abused following a security incident. Rotate keys and check usage now.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Nvidia is notifying users of its Brev AI developer platform of a security incident: unauthorized activity Oct 4-20, 2026. Brev-provisioned SSH keys may have been exposed. Rotate keys.

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, names, email addresses accessed.

author: evansims
text: The Bitwarden CLI supply-chain attack went straight for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex config files, which hold live tokens to repos and cloud.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest worm arms 42 legitimate GitHub repositories for supply-chain attacks (JFrog disclosure, GitHub/npm).

author: ddimitrovv22
text: Binance lost ~$6.3B from its hot wallets in about 20 minutes, initial entry via one engineer's compromised laptop; Chainalysis and TRM attribute it to North Korea.

author: MoneyGrid7
text: Black October breach recap: Railway lost customer environment variables, OpenCode leaked API keys, TiDB Cloud confirmed stolen credentials got an attacker inside, Coinbase and Warp exposed through a vendor, Capcom lost 11.7M accounts.

author: VECERTRadar
text: Alleged (unconfirmed) sale of a critical 0-day exploit and 10M+ taxpayer records from Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes by actor MARLANWG.

author: h3xivall
text: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 is being exploited in the wild now. CVSS 10, integer overflow in the CI regex compiler, RCE from a crafted pipeline config. Fixed in 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8. If you self-host, today's the day https://t.co/CTR9KudG5P

author: lyrie_ai
text:
One leaked key. Deleted in 3 hours. Still valid 136 days later.

• LiteLLM: an admin key was committed to a public repo on May 27. The file was deleted about 3 hours later, but the key was never revoked. An attacker used it on Oct 10, per LiteLLM
• The escalation: that system https://t.co/aOTeUpHVCQ

author: CyberAlertpit
text: Linux Alert: CVE-2026-98432. Critical IPv4 kernel flaw may allow remote crashes and memory corruption without login. Admins should check their kernel version and patch affected systems immediately.

author: TheHackersNews
text: A critical flaw in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud (CVE-2026-112816, CVSS 10.0) lets attackers impersonate trusted clients without their private keys. Requires HTTPS API access and a trusted client's public certificate; cluster, VM and possible host root access.

author: thesystemprompt
text: Northflank: assume all env vars were decrypted. Customers report AI API keys abused after a breach flagged by Wiz on Oct 30. Ninth AI dev platform hit this month; Wiz tracked stolen keys making ~2.5M Bedrock calls, $100k+ at list. Rotate now.

author: CobaltHere
text: New malware uses AI to decide which stolen data is worth more: this infostealer grabs passwords and wallet seeds, then asks an LLM what you're worth; if the model refuses, it tries another.

author: HACKTIFY_
text: Running self-managed GitLab CE/EE? CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) is under active exploitation and enables unauthenticated RCE via crafted CI/CD regex. Upgrade to 19.4.2, 19.3.5 or 19.2.8 now.

author: BeyondDraft
text: Follow-up: fake Claude Code extension was 2.1.312 and 2.1.313. Microsoft: never on VS Marketplace or npm. Anthropic says its systems weren't compromised. Evidence points to Cursor's marketplace only.

author: hernavss
text: OpenCode: a breach exposed saved AI provider keys for 1.4% of its Console users. Some balances got drained. Rotate keys and set spend alerts.

author: cryptowatchdesk
text: Intersect has told Cardano stake pool operators to check their servers for CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel flaw (CVSS 9.8). Ubuntu's fix hasn't shipped yet. No exploitation has been reported.

author: harundotdev
text: October for devops: Railway got hacked (rotate keys), Northflank got hacked (rotate keys), GitHub Actions got hacked (rotate keys), Cursor marketplace got hacked (check authorized_keys, rotate keys).

author: Python_s_
text: 26,400 API-validated credentials exposed across public Gitee repositories (Oct 28, 2026). Large-scale credential exposure; no confirmed Gitee platform breach or CVE.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Apache MINA JavaNativeMessageDecoder untrusted deserialization RCE (CVE-2026-118636). Apache MINA 3.0 mina-core deserializes attacker-controlled frame bytes via ObjectInputStream.readObject() with no class filter.
